tasks.short: Discuss assigned duties and coordinate instructional support

steps.what: Review assigned duties and the teacher's current instructional plan
Discuss assigned duties with classroom teachers and resolve instructional coordination needs
Write agreed support duties in the existing shared classroom plan
Send the agreed support allocation to the relevant classroom staff

tasks.design: Link the current support allocation and reuse the existing classroom-plan headings in {DOCS}. Retain the teacher discussion, separately update actual duties and send the final allocation through {CHAT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current plan and recreating stable duty headings repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and existing allocation fields remove those actions.
tasks.still_hard: Pupil needs and teacher priorities change during the day.
tasks.human_edge: Clarify responsibilities and raise conflicts promptly.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated duty-plan handling around coordination.

evidence.claim: Current-plan links and stable duty fields can reduce repeated handling without replacing instructional coordination.

assumptions: The support allocation is an existing shared plan used by the teacher and assistant. No separate meeting minutes or activity log is created.

The assistant checks current allocation and lesson context in s1, obtains duties in s2 and captures named duty, time and support responsibility in s3. Capture and ordinary saves remain within 18 writing hours; unclear responsibility is resolved manually with the teacher.
The current-plan link removes 1 of 10 retrieval hours; reusable duty headings and unchanged context remove 2 of 20 writing hours. No automatic assignment or send is implied.
The s4 gate concerns its actual final internal message, not permission for the author to save the plan.
unknowns: Whether duty changes already use a shared plan
research_questions: Does the existing plan structure remove actual repeated writing without duplicating duty communication?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual support allocation

incremental.description: Maintain the current allocation link and headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact updated duty allocation and staff recipients checked in s3; changed duties, time or recipients require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=97, gross 3 less 0.5 upkeep gives 2.5 net. Already direct current-plan access retaining all retrieval and 19.5 writing hours has its saving offset by upkeep. Reusable duty headings retaining 9.5 retrieval and 18.5 writing hours plus other 70 and 0.5 upkeep yield 1.5 net. Teacher discussion and actual staff send remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct students in practical daily living skills

steps.what: Review the teacher's daily living skill objective and specific support precautions
Prepare the physical hygiene, safety or food preparation materials
Instruct students by demonstrating the daily living skill with suitable support
Support practical attempts and judge when students need further help
outputs: supported practice and observed assistance needs

tasks.design: Use a direct current-objective reference in {DOCS} and the existing support information in {LMS}. Retain physical preparation, demonstration and supported practice; no newly required practice log is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small amount of repeated objective navigation surrounds practical instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links can expose the current objective without repeating a document search.
tasks.still_hard: Assistance must match the student's practical ability and immediate safety needs.
tasks.human_edge: Build independence while giving only the help actually needed.
tasks.altitude: Preserve practical skill teaching with slightly easier context access.

reach.learn: Distinguish independent performance from performance achieved with help

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and plans, allowing current support context to be referenced; no practical instruction saving is established.

assumptions: The current objective and support precautions already guide instruction. No record of every hygiene or food preparation attempt is assumed.

The assistant verifies objective and precautions in s1 and observes actual student attempts in s4, with all capture and checking counted. Missing or unclear precautions are clarified with the teacher manually before practice.
A direct objective link removes only 0.5 of 10 lookup hours; reading the precautions remains. Templates and views do not reduce the 90 physical preparation, demonstration and support hours.
No new system, generated instruction or periodic upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether objective navigation is already direct
research_questions: Is even the assumed half-hour of repeated objective search present in the current workflow?

already_counted.description: Read and check actual objective and precautions

incremental.description: Existing context link adds no recurring service

approvals.approved_version: Exact daily living skill demonstration for the current students and checked precautions; changed skill or circumstances require reconsideration
Exact practical assistance and instruction delivered during the current attempt; changed hazards or assistance needs require immediate judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=99.5 with no upkeep gives 0.5 net. Already direct objectives retain all ten lookup hours and yield zero. Partial navigation improvement retaining 9.75 lookup plus other 90 hours yields 0.25 net. Practical teaching and safety support remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Distribute physical teaching materials to students

steps.what: Read the teacher's material instructions and identify the required student versions
Select and sort textbooks, workbooks, papers and pencils for the group
Distribute the prepared teaching materials to the intended students
Check that students have the appropriate versions and replace missing items

tasks.design: Retain reading the teacher's material directions, physical sorting, distribution and checking. A template in {DOCS} does not remove handling textbooks, paper or pencils; no inventory write is required by this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The repeated work is physical movement of materials.
tasks.enabler_now: No identified software operation removes this material handling.
tasks.still_hard: Students may need different accessible versions or immediate replacements.
tasks.human_edge: Make sure each child can actually use the materials received.

reach.learn: Make required versions clear before distribution

evidence.claim: Physical material distribution has no identified digital operation to remove within this task.

assumptions: The task is distributing existing materials, not creating worksheets, ordering stock or recording library loans. No distribution log is added.

The assistant reads actual material/version directions in s1 and checks physical sets and recipients in s2-s4. All verification time is counted; unclear versions are clarified manually with the teacher.
The five instruction-reading hours are substantive checking, not repeated searching or transcription. Native views, templates or settings remove none of the priced operations.
No new system or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether any materials are individually loaned under a separate recorded-loan process
research_questions: Does current observation identify a real record write inside this distribution task?

already_counted.description: Read required material versions and check distribution

approvals.approved_version: Exact physical material versions and intended student recipients checked during distribution; changed versions or recipients require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=100 and no upkeep gives zero. Uniform material sets and differentiated versions both retain direction checking, physical sorting, delivery and completeness checks; no actual duplicate record operation is identified.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize and supervise developmental games and recreation

steps.what: Review existing game instructions and student support precautions
Choose and adapt games for the group's developmental and participation needs
Write the activity arrangement in the existing classroom activity plan
Arrange physical equipment and the play area for the chosen activity
Explain and supervise games while adapting support to students' actual participation

tasks.design: Link existing game instructions and reuse the classroom activity-plan layout in {DOCS}, with current support context from {LMS}. Keep activity selection, physical setup and supervision human; no trailing recreation log is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated instruction searching and activity-plan structure add preparation work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native references and existing plan headings can remove those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Developmental suitability and safe participation require observation and adaptation.
tasks.human_edge: Keep play inclusive and respond to the group as it changes.
tasks.altitude: Reduce real activity-plan repetition around supervised play.

reach.learn: Make adaptations usable during actual play

evidence.claim: Existing game-reference links and activity-plan layouts can reduce repeated preparation without replacing physical supervision.

assumptions: The activity arrangement is already written in the classroom plan for preparation and staff use. No new completion report or recreation log is introduced.

The assistant verifies current instructions and precautions in s1, chooses adaptations in s2 and captures game, equipment and adaptations in s3. Capture is included in eight retained writing hours; unclear precautions are manually checked with the teacher.
Direct game references remove 1 of 10 retrieval hours. Existing activity headings and reusable equipment-list structure remove 2 of 10 writing hours; actual adaptations and substantive checks remain.
Ordinary author saves remain included without approval. No automatic booking, equipment order or staff notification is implied.
unknowns: Whether an existing activity-plan layout is consistently used
research_questions: Does native reuse remove the specified preparation actions after individual adaptations?

already_counted.description: Capture actual activity adaptations and arrangement

incremental.description: Maintain current game references and plan layout

approvals.approved_version: Exact game explanation and supervision support delivered to current students in the prepared setting; changed conditions or needs require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=97, gross 3 less 0.5 upkeep gives 2.5 net. Games needing wholly different accessible formats retain all retrieval and 9.5 writing hours, with upkeep offsetting the saving. Reusable existing structure retaining 9.5 retrieval and 8.5 writing hours plus other 80 and 0.5 upkeep yields 1.5 net. Selection, physical setup and supervision stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve personal special education support while reducing genuine shared-plan repetition.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish real classroom plans from unnecessary activity logs
role.ambitious_version: An assistant with clear duties and usable activities who personally supports practical independence and safe student participation.
